verdict.rationale: The evidence shows HubSpot publishes API reference documentation describing endpoints such as GET /marketing/v3/emails. Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Static endpoint documentation is adjacent to the story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
